latest.title: Apoc-Air 0.2.0
latest.notes:
# Apoc-Air 0.2.0

Needs SigmaMod 2.0: the gyroplane is a Lua asset now.

## The gyroplane

- **A Lua asset**: `sigma_assets/apocagyro.lua` (9 KB) replaces `apocagyro.json` (108 KB). It is built from
  SigmaMod's parts library and makes the same gyroplane.
- **The flight controls are a library**: `sigma_assets/apocair/flight.lua` (`require "apocair.flight"`,
  `flight.controls(g, { input = ..., rotor = ... })`) holds the keys and mouse to the stick, pedals and throttle,
  the hand shove and the stabiliser. Another aircraft can use it as it is.
- **Parked means parked**: with nobody in the seat the wheel brakes are on. Before, getting out let go of them, and
  a gyroplane left on a slope rolled away.
- **The stabiliser is off with nobody aboard** (and when one spawns), so it doesn't work the rotor head of an empty
  aircraft. It comes back on when you sit down; V still switches it.
- The seat is where it belongs on every copy: SigmaMod 2.0 places an object made in the asset only once the object
  it is placed at exists.

## Install

Unzip into `Apocalypter/BepInEx/plugins`, replacing the `ApocAir` folder. Delete `ApocAir/sigma_assets/apocagyro.json`
if it is still there from 0.1.x (with both, the `.lua` wins, but the old file is dead weight).

latest.notes:
# Apocapocket 2.0.10

Weapon recovery can now run after a puff while a joint is still lit. Version 2.0.9 protected the entire burn phase, which
skipped recovery in the reported case. The guard now distinguishes the lighting animation from ongoing smoking: both
smoking arms must already be hidden, the lighting FSM must be idle and burn progress must be valid before recovery is allowed.

Lighting and unfinished/unknown animation states stay protected. Native smoking continues to own burn progress, held Smoke
input, lights, consumption, discarded items and weed effects. Recovery does not replay End or reset the joint.
Extra-slot weapons and parked native hosts are preserved through the existing inventory transaction.

The watchdog also covers a selected weapon whose native hand handler remains inactive despite visible weapon prompts, and
honours the native re-equip delay when game time is slowed.

Recovery and state-snapshot messages require Debug/VerboseLog = true. Default logging stays quiet. If the issue persists,
enable that setting, restart and reproduce the puff/weapon draw, then remain in gameplay for at least 15 seconds and copy
BepInEx/LogOutput.log. Snapshots identify animation, hand, pause, menu, vehicle, save and transaction guards without clearing
another mod's pause or moving another mod's held object.

Replace the previous DLL with the included BepInEx/plugins/Apocapocket/Apocapocket.dll and restart. Keep only one plugin DLL.
Existing configuration, bindings and save format are retained.

Verified with 173 production-code checks and native Mono/Harmony checks. The affected player's reproduction still needs
validation; their prior log confirmed 2.0.9 loaded but did not capture the stalled weapon states.

mods.name: Apocasaver
mods.author: DeonUrist
mods.summary: Autosave into the slot you are playing and give your saves names.

latest.title: Apocasaver 2.0.4
latest.notes:
# Apocasaver 2.0.4

Fixes terrain-streaming hitches caused by repeatedly searching all loaded objects for missing location templates. Thanks to **@Wad67** for the profiling and [PR #1](https://github.com/DeonUrist/Apocasaver/pull/1), merged with the original contributor commit preserved.

The [follow-up fixes in PR #2](https://github.com/DeonUrist/Apocasaver/pull/2) reduce additional save and terrain work:

- Resolve templates from the actual pool prefab, keep same-name prefabs distinct, and reset template caches across scene/session changes.
- Reuse the terrain-history snapshot until history changes, while isolating writes made by load callbacks.
- Process only moved or deleted pool objects; skip empty movement batches.
- Check cleanup eligibility before building one reference index. Periodic cleanup scans stop while `CleanSaves` is disabled; enabling it starts fresh distance timing.
- Batch hand-pose metadata into the active save transaction or one delayed disk write. Failed delayed writes retain pending poses, and transactional reads see the latest cache.

Validation: release build with zero warnings/errors, **100 managed checks**, **78 isolated native Unity checks**, and **93 native checks with Apocapatrol 2.13.0 / Apocapocket 2.0.10** passed. Native fixtures cover pooling, history restoration, reference protection, metadata batching, real disk-lock retry and save rollback. They are constructed fixtures rather than a complete gameplay replay. [Verification details](https://github.com/DeonUrist/Apocasaver/blob/v2.0.4/docs/2.0.4-verification.md).

Extract `Apocasaver-2.0.4.zip` into the game directory, replacing `BepInEx/plugins/Apocasaver.dll`, then restart the game. Requires BepInEx 5; optional companion mods are packaged separately.

# Engine Sim 1.8.1

## Fixes

- **The starter moves the car in gear on a worn-out engine again.** An engine whose table gives no `peak_torque`

mods.summary: Cram your own 3D stuff into Apocalypter without installing the bloated Unity editor. Ships with a 1981 Mitsubishi Sigma and its Astron 2000 engine.

latest.title: SigmaMod 2.2.0
latest.notes:
# SigmaMod 2.2.0

## Attachable items

- **`parts.attachable(g, o)`**: a loose item that attaches to vehicles the way the game's metal plates do. Held
  against a vehicle's part, Use fixes it there: it becomes part of the vehicle and moves with it. The game's tools
  take it off again, and it falls loose with its own mass. Its name shows on screen while it's looked at.
- **Items of many colliders pick up whole.** The game's grab takes whatever collider its ray hits, so an item whose
  colliders are other objects had one collider pulled out of it and the rest left behind. Given `colliders` (objects
  whose meshes become its colliders) or `collider_groups` (objects that already carry colliders, such as an exported
  vehicle's), the item is built as the game builds a car door: a trigger box round its mesh that the grab finds first,
  a small solid sphere (`grip`) as the collider the game switches while it's held, and the colliders switched off in
  the hand and on again when let go. Without either, its own mesh is its collider.
- An example plate from scratch: `examples/metal_plate.lua`.

## Fallen through the ground

- **Anything that falls through the map is put back on it.** A body that falls through keeps falling, and after some
  minutes it is far enough down to lock the game up in its rendering. Every two seconds each body is checked against
  the ground under it: one more than 100 m below and still falling is put back on the ground right above, at rest, and
  the log names it (`fall watch:`). Something resting underground, in a cave, isn't falling and stays.
- With `Debug.VerboseLog`, a body 50 m under the ground is reported before it is that far down.

## Hot reload

- A file that fails to load is reported once and tried again when it changes. A new asset that failed was tried and
  logged again on every check, about once a second.
- With `Debug.VerboseLog`, a frame trace for ten minutes after a hot reload (`BepInEx/SigmaMod-frames.txt`): each
  frame's stages written as they pass, so a freeze leaves the stage it stopped in as the file's last line.

## Install

Unzip into `Apocalypter/BepInEx/plugins`, replacing the `SigmaMod` folder.

First standalone release. Female raiders in the wasteland: female models and textures, their own voice lines, female corpses, and the appearance saved with the game. Ships its Models and Sounds folders next to the DLL.

Part of the Apocaraider split: **Gunplay**, **GunplayHUD**, **NPCAI** and **WomenOfWasteland** replace the combined Apocaraider (now frozen). Each works on its own and with any combination of the others. **Remove Apocaraider** when installing these, otherwise its hooks run twice. Old Apocaraider settings are imported on first run.

**Install:** unzip into `BepInEx\plugins` (creates `BepInEx\plugins\WomenOfWasteland\`).
